title: Dia launch notes: every feature signed 'Shipped by' with the builder's handwritten name
note: Launch article inspo. Lydia loves that Dia's Mac v1.58.0 launch notes (2026-11-19) end each feature with 'Shipped by' plus the contributor's signature in a handwritten script (Charlie, Rosey, Connor, Ali, Sébastien, Tracey), some with a round avatar. Two-column grid of feature blurbs on warm off-white, ABC Oracle body type.
